Paul — thanks for the doc and the quick note. Short answers up front: yes we can support self-billing for CH MWST with the right paperwork, and we can reissue the October invoice and flag the customer copy for "tax treatment: recipient liable (MWST)" so you have the notation for reclaim. A few details below and a proposed next step.

Checklist we need from Alpine before we reissue:
- Signed self-billing agreement (we have a template)
- Copy of MWST registration (your attached certificate looks good)
- Confirmation of billing entity (AlpineLogistics GmbH, CH) and payment instructions for settlement

Operational notes:
- If you sign the self-billing agreement we will reissue invoice-20261001 as a self-billed document with the MWST notation and zero-rated Redwood VAT on our internal ledger.
- Payment hold: we can expedite release once the agreement and certificate are on file; otherwise AP may require hold until tax treatment is validated.

Marissa — can you confirm whether our template requires additional CH-specific clauses or a countersignature flow? Neha — assuming legal is OK, will finance need additional internal approvals to reclassify the invoice?

I can send the self-billing template and a DocuSign link once we confirm.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Quick question on VAT handling for Alpine

Ben / Neha / Paul — quick legal note: our standard self-billing template covers EU reverse-charge regimes, but Switzerland (MWST) has some administrative differences. Two small items to include in the agreement for CH:
1) A clause confirming Alpine will accept the self-billed invoice as the taxable document for Swiss authorities (explicit acceptance).
2) Data-retention clause clarifying Alpine will retain the supplier copies for 10 years per CH requirements and Redwood will provide machine-readable PDF copies on request.

If Paul can countersign the attached self-billing agreement PDF after we add those two lines I'm fine. No additional countersignatures needed internally.

Neha — from finance side: once signed, do a reissue flow and tag as "self-billed — recipient liable (MWST)". That should be sufficient for Alpine to reclaim. If Alpine intends to deduct input tax immediately, ask them to confirm their reclaim window so we can timestamp the reissue appropriately.

Marissa
General Counsel, Redwood Inference
